nom: La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Gel B5 Repair Gel for Cracked Skin, 1.35oz

avis.titre: Soothing Post-Laser!!  Ideal for Aging Skin ~Soothing Post-Laser!!  Ideal for Aging Skin ~
avis.texte: I just had my first CO2 Laser treatment and once you get past the required use of occlusives (Aquaphor, Doctor Rogers Healing Balm, Vaseline etc.), I was searching for something lighter that allowed my skin to breath yet soothed the dry, itching discomfort. La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Gel was the answer! After laser treatment, you can experience discomfort for up to 10 days. This gel is super lightweight, spreads easily and is not greasy. A small amount easily covered my face and neck. I like the fact that it is fragrance free - I experienced zero irritation. I found the product extremely soothing and really sped up my recovery with dryness and itchiness. This product was more effective than the lotion I was given my the laser specialist! I already use La Roche-Posay facial cleanser and love it. I am adding this product to my skin care regimen even after my laser recovery is complete. Ideal if you are looking for an effective moisturizer that is lightweight and really works on dry/irritated skin.

avis.titre: Great product for summer, or for combo skin that gets dehydrated
avis.texte: I love the Cicaplast B5 balm, but I wanted something different my congested summer skin. This is it! Every bit as hydrating but a lighter texture for summer. The moisture lasts all day and the gel isn't sticky or tacky. It even still works well over tretinoin and other strong actives. No fragrance and great for sensitive, reactive skin.

I’ve been really impressed with La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Gel B5. The lightweight gel texture feels soothing and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin greasy or sticky. It has helped calm dry, irritated areas and noticeably improved the appearance of my skin barrier after just a few uses. I especially love that it’s fragrance-free and gentle enough for sensitive skin. It layers well with the rest of my skincare routine and works great on dry patches, redness, and minor irritation. A little goes a long way

avis.titre: Excellent Repair Gel for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using this La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Gel B5, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine. The gel is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling soothed and hydrated without any greasy residue. It’s great for helping calm irritated or dry areas, and it works well on sensitive skin. A little goes a long way, and the quality is exactly what I expect from La Roche-Posay. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: The best for damaged skin barrier
avis.texte: I damaged my skin barrier really badly from the winter time and tried several things that did not work. I was really losing hope and found this from doing research. I’d been using this for less than a week and my skin is just about back to normal after months of struggles! I would buy this again and would recommend it. Good luck!

Based off some tik tok I saw, I bought this hoping to help the irritation above my eyebrows. Turns out, a thin layer before I go to bed has immensely helped with the wrinkles that were starting to set it. It’s long lasting, has no smell, and a little goes a long way. Will repurchase when I’m out!

avis.titre: A Must-Have in My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I honestly can’t live without this product. It’s become a staple in my skincare routine because it works so well whenever my skin is irritated, dry, or healing. The gel absorbs quickly, isn’t greasy or sticky, and leaves a protective layer that helps my skin recover without feeling heavy. I’ve used it on dry patches, chapped skin, and areas that needed extra care after irritation, and it has consistently helped my skin feel more comfortable and look better much faster. A little goes a long way, so the tube lasts longer than you’d expect. I’ve tried other repair products over the years, but I always come back to this one. If you’re looking for something to help support your skin’s natural healing process, I highly recommend keeping a tube on hand. I won’t be without it.
I’ve been using tretinoin, and my eyes are extremely dry. Applying thick eye cream and vaseline or ointment didn’t work until I found this product.

avis.titre: Mi piel se siente mucho más hidratada
avis.texte: Este gel reparador superó mis expectativas. Tiene una textura ligera que se absorbe rápido y no deja la piel pegajosa, por lo que es muy cómodo usarlo tanto de día como de noche. Lo he aplicado en zonas donde mi piel estaba reseca e irritada y he notado que se siente más hidratada y con mejor aspecto después de unos días de uso. Además, una pequeña cantidad rinde bastante, así que el envase dura más de lo que esperaba. La presentación llegó perfectamente sellada y en excelentes condiciones. Si buscas un gel que ayude a mantener la piel hidratada y favorezca su recuperación, esta es una excelente opción. Sin duda volvería a comprarlo.

I had to share, for years I’ve battled with perioral dermatitis, used two different prescriptions, oral and topical which only help for a short period, where the symptoms did not go away completely . I was fortunate to come across this product which I used with azelaic acid. Within the space of two months my face was finally completely healed. I’ve been watching for flare ups and nothing to date. It has since been a part of my daily routine.

This barrier cream from La Roche Posay comes in a tube and is cloudy white in color. It is kind of a gel like consistency and spreads out over a large amount of skin with a small dot. It is pretty greasy on the skin surface and doesn't soak in super well. It does moisturize very well, and didn't cause any irritation on dry, chapped, cracked hands and fingers. I found the price point a little high for the amount, but this is a well-known brand. I'm not sure about the effectiveness of the cica or b vitamins, so time will tell if that makes a difference vs. regular glycerin skin protectants.

I took a while to write this review because I was testing the product for some time, and I love what it has done for my skin—so much so that I ended up buying more from this same brand. It isn't cheap, but it is definitely worth having.

avis.titre: Great skin protector / Muy buen protector de piel
avis.texte: Really good for calming and protecting the skin. It helps with healing and leaves the skin soft without feeling greasy. Muy buen protector de piel. Ayuda a calmar, proteger y reparar, dejando la piel suave sin sensación grasosa.

This gel has completely healed my skin barrier, my face has never looked better, and bonus it has completely healed my severe sunburn with no peeling. I love the texture of this more than the balm. No stickiness, very moisturizing, no color or white cast so it works well under makeup and makes a nice primer. I wish it were bigger for the high price, because I would buy in bulk and use it everywhere if it were more affordable. My skin absolutely loves this stuff. :)

avis.titre: WARNING! Sent a tiny sample size tube, not full size listed
avis.texte: I don't know if this is associated with the real La Roche Posay company or if it is a drop shipper, but DO NOT purchase this listing for this item. Title of the product and photos clearly show this to be a 1.35 Fl Oz tube and instead I was sent a 0.1 Fl Oz tiny little sample tube and still charged the full $22.99. I would assume this was a mistake but based on many other reviews it may not be. Costing me more in my time and money to bring this to be returned for a refund, but I am going to do it because WTF! This is a total rip off. I LOVE La Roche Posay and their products, but I want to make sure others do not fall prey to this listing and lose money and time.
Encargué mi ciclaplast de 1.3 fl oz siempre me llega la grande por 22 dólares y ahora me llegó una en miniatura que casi ni contenido tiene por dentro.
Just received and got a sample size and the film protector once you open was not there and it seems empty.
I received a tiny sample of the product (.1 oz). It actually says it's a sample and not for sale on the container.

avis.titre: Face Feels Nice After At Home Treatments
avis.texte: Sometimes I use an at-home microneedling device (the automatic ones, not the rollers), and microdermabrasion, and I wanted something good for my skin afterwards. I feel this helps my skin look and feel less irritated, maybe even helping the recovery process. I can't truly say, but that's how it feels to me. It doesn't make my skin feel gross, like sticky or greasy. Make sure you use a little at a time when you apply it, and definitely don't waste it by applying too much. Since I only use this after something like one of the at-home treatments I mentioned, I feel it's a good value. I don't do those things too often, but I see myself grabbing another tube of this when I run out. Since we all have different skin, it might be better for some than others. Personally, I like it.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way! Great to have during these winter months!
avis.texte: This La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Gel B5 is nice! It’s supposed to help protect and relieve areas with chapped, cracked skin and helps soothe a disrupted skin barrier. The tube has a skinny applicator but be careful, a lot comes out with a little squeeze and a little goes a LONG way!! It does have a weird scent to it at first, but once absorbed, the smell completely goes away and there is no lingering scent at all. I thankfully have not had any recent procedures or stitches etc, so I’m unsure how it works post-procedure or post-stitches, but I have lots of dry patches on my face due to this cold weather and my husbands hands are so dry and cracked from working outside. We both have been using it and it really helps both of our dry and cracked skin! It absorbs really nicely and doesn’t take long to dry. We are excited to have this around for the winter! It definitely has helped us both a lot so far!

I'm a huge fan of La Roche Possay their products are very soft on the skin and don't leave it irritated. We use this cicaplast gel for when our daughters get a scratch or when they have cracked skin in the winter and it works wonders!! I use it after my laser sessions on my face and love how smooth my skin feels afterwards it's very gentle on the skin a little goes a long way it's very hydrating as well, fragrance free and good for sensitive skin.

This is a genuine product. It is medical grade product and is labeled as a drug. It contains glycerin 21%, the labels use indicates it "temporarily protects and helps relieve chapped or cracked skin." It comes in a long skinny tube. A fine line of the serum like cream comes out for precise application. After applying it leaves somewhat of a reside on your skin. It also contains Panthenol, Madecassoside (copper, zinc, manganese), hyaluronic acid, and La Roche-Psay Thermal Spring Water.
